title: Huntsville AL 03-02-02
author: Damian Loback

games.note: Bye ('dont ask me why'); counted in the final 6 (+37). Loback then played Andy a casual game against his Invasion deck.

decks.description: Build the Death Star with shields

decks.objective: Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers

summary: Damian Loback went 2–1 with a bye at a tournament in Huntsville, Alabama, on 2 March 2002, losing to Andy's Senate deck with his Build the Death Star deck and beating Chris McClure and Efrige with X-wing Hidden Base.
notes: Unnamed local event: named 'March 2002 Huntsville tournament' (no Huntsville event in March 2002 on the List; earlier Huntsville events use '<Month YYYY> Huntsville tournament'). Date from the title (03-02-02), posted 3 March 2002.
Format Premiere - Theed Palace (Premiere - Original VS1 starts 9 March 2002); Andy's casual-game deck was Invasion (a Theed Palace objective).

'Andy' is first name only (no page); not linked to Andy McClure although he is the known Huntsville player. 'Efrige' kept as written (no page). 'Chris Mclure' mapped to existing [[Chris McClure]] (Alabama).
'Build the death star' names no objective, so none linked; Hidden Base linked for 'Hb flip'.
Finish not stated. Round 4 bye recorded as a game row with no opponent or result.
Paul Myers and John Anderson are mentioned (deck opinions; Anderson co-organising a cash tournament), not as players here; not mapped to the modern pages.

Post-tournament paragraph has a slur ('stupid wigger') and a crude remark aimed at an unnamed, unidentifiable Taco Bell employee; judged not a hold under the named/identifiable-person rule, but flagged.
